mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment_qr ( qr_token, member_id, user_card_id, status, expires_at, created_at ) VALUES ( #{qrToken}, #{memberId}, #{userCardId}, #{status}, #{expiresAt}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT qr_token AS qrToken, member_id AS memberId, user_card_id AS userCardId, status AS status, expires_at AS expiresAt, used_at AS usedAt, payment_id AS paymentId FROM payment_qr WHERE qr_token = #{qrToken}

SELECT qr_token AS qrToken, member_id AS memberId, user_card_id AS userCardId, status AS status, expires_at AS expiresAt, used_at AS usedAt, payment_id AS paymentId FROM payment_qr WHERE qr_token = #{qrToken} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE payment_qr SET status = 'EXPIRED' WHERE qr_token = #{qrToken} AND status = 'READY'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO expense ( member_id, user_card_id, category_id, merchant_id, merchant_name, amount, payment_date, input_type, payment_status, approval_status, applied_benefit_id, discount_amount, payment_type, is_interest_free, created_at ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{userCardId}, #{categoryId}, #{merchantId}, #{merchantName}, #{paymentAmount}, NOW(), 'PAYMENT', 'APPROVED', 'CONFIRMED', NULL, 0, 'CARD', 'N', NOW() )

INSERT INTO payment ( member_id, user_card_id, payment_channel, is_recommend_based, expense_id, merchant_id, merchant_name, payment_amount, payment_status, requested_at, completed_at ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{userCardId}, 'QR', 'N', #{expenseId}, #{merchantId}, #{merchantName}, #{paymentAmount}, 'SUCCESS', NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE payment_qr SET status = 'USED', used_at = NOW(), payment_id = #{paymentId} WHERE qr_token = #{qrToken} AND status = 'READY'
UPDATE payment_qr SET status = 'FAILED', failed_at = NOW(), fail_reason = #{failReason} WHERE qr_token = #{qrToken} AND status = 'READY'
